# Showcase assets / 展示素材

These assets support the English and Chinese repository READMEs and GitHub repository presentation. Product screenshots and demonstration data are described separately.

这些素材用于中英文 README 与 GitHub 仓库展示。桌面截图和样例数据均在展示处注明，不表示所有界面来自同一个版本。

| Asset / 素材 | Source / 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| `workbench.png` | Desktop capture from `Forsion-Website/assets/screenshots/coding.png`, placed on a clean 1600 × 900 presentation canvas. The crop removes desktop pixels outside the app window without changing the UI. / 来自原官网的真实桌面截图；仅去除应用窗口外的桌面杂边，并放入 1600 × 900 展示画布，界面内容未改动。 |
| `calendar.png` | Desktop capture from `Forsion-Website/assets/screenshots/calendar.png`, cleaned and framed on the same 1600 × 900 presentation canvas. / 来自原官网的真实日历截图；仅清理窗口外杂边，并使用同一 1600 × 900 展示画布。 |
| `notes.png` | Production `UnifiedPage` renderer at Genesis source commit `172d9bae`, using the public fixture in `docs/showcase/note-sample.md`, presented on the same 1600 × 900 canvas. / 真实笔记编辑器渲染的公开样例；不是真实用户资料或一次 AI 执行的产出。 |
| `logo.svg` | Existing Forsion logo from `Forsion-Website/assets/Forsion-LOGO3.svg`. / 复用现有扶桑标志。 |
| `social-preview.png` | Lossless 1280 × 640 browser-canvas export of `docs/showcase/social-preview.html`; the complete product frame stays inside the safe area. / `docs/showcase/social-preview.html` 的无损画布导出；产品截图完整位于安全区内。 |

For GitHub Social Preview, upload `social-preview.png` in the repository settings.

GitHub 的 Social Preview 可使用 `social-preview.png`。

The proposed GitHub About text is: **Your local AI workbench. Bring agents, knowledge, and everyday work together.** Repository settings are not changed by this branch.

建议 GitHub About 简介：**Your local AI workbench. Bring agents, knowledge, and everyday work together.** 本分支提供文案与素材，仓库设置未修改。
